name: gosqlx-mcp
description: SQL parsing, formatting, linting, security scanning and metadata extraction, built on the GoSQLX Go SDK. 7 MCP tools: validate_sql, format_sql, parse_sql, extract_metadata, security_scan, lint_sql and analyze_sql. Dialect-aware validation for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift and ClickHouse. Zero-copy tokenizer, race-free, with object pooling.

tools.name: validate_sql
tools.description: Check whether SQL is syntactically valid, optionally for a specific dialect (dialect parameter: generic, postgresql, mysql, mariadb, sqlserver, oracle, sqlite, snowflake, bigquery, redshift, clickhouse). Returns {valid: bool, error?: string, dialect?: string}.

tools.name: format_sql
tools.description: Pretty-print SQL: one clause per line, configurable indent size, optional upper-case keywords and trailing semicolon. Comments are not kept. Returns {formatted_sql, options}.

tools.name: parse_sql
tools.description: Parse SQL and return an AST summary: the statement count and the type of each statement.

tools.name: extract_metadata
tools.description: Extract all tables, columns, and functions referenced in a SQL query. Useful for schema dependency analysis, query auditing, and impact analysis.

tools.name: security_scan
tools.description: Scan SQL for injection attack patterns: tautologies (1=1), UNION-based attacks, stacked queries, comment bypasses, blind injection probes. Returns severity-classified findings (critical/high/medium/low) with descriptions and remediation suggestions.

tools.name: lint_sql
tools.description: Lint SQL with the same 10 rules as `gosqlx lint` (L001–L010): trailing whitespace, mixed indentation, consecutive blank lines, indentation depth, line length (>100), column alignment, keyword case (upper), comma placement (trailing), aliasing consistency and redundant whitespace. Returns {violation_count, violations} with line/column positions.

tools.name: analyze_sql
tools.description: Run validate, parse, metadata, security, lint and format concurrently and return one composite report. The most efficient way to get a full review of a query in one call.

linting.note: The GoSQLX CLI and Go SDK provide 30 rules (L001–L030); the MCP lint_sql tool applies L001–L010.
